szoveg_eredeti:
The speed, the space, the money, the risk — racing is one of the hardest things to film. Redline, our latest Kling AI Original, powered by Kling 4.0, takes on all those challenges without compromising on the human part of why people race in the first place.

With adrenaline-pumping racing sequences and mesmerizing performances, this could be the most cinematic AI film we have ever seen!

Written & Directed by: Stephane Benini (@BeniniStep9801 )
Edited by: Yves Dalbiez (@YvesDalbiez )
Produced by: Rodrigo Orozco
Post & VFX by: Bruno Detante (@brunodetante )
Sound Design & Music by: un.studios
